Searching for the frontend source file that creates ConnectRPC service clients.

Checking the web/frontend directory for ConnectRPC client creation.
The ConnectRPC service clients appear to be created in `web/src/connect.ts`.

`web/src/connect.ts` contains the ConnectRPC service client creation logic using `createClient` from `@connectrpc/connect`.

All other frontend files import from `@/connect`.
